$comment: Layer 0 thresholds for scripts/evals-run.mjs. Set from corpus percentiles on 2026-09-24 (see docs/wp/wp41-progress.md). 'warn' flags a page for review. 'fail' blocks a new or edited page in CI. Change a threshold only with a progress-log note explaining why.

llm.$comment: WP41-S2. LLM layers (claim extraction, verification, judges) call OpenRouter through lib/evals/llm.ts under a hard cap: EVALS_MAX_USD, default and maximum $10. Prices are read live from OpenRouter, never hard-coded. Pin exact model IDs (never openrouter/auto) in judges; check them with npm run evals:ping -- --live.

judges.$comment: WP41-S4. Layer 3 thresholds, applied to the median of valid judge scores per dimension (rubric: evals/rubric.md). Calibrate in S5 before tightening.

claims.$comment: WP41-S3. Layer 1 (extract claims) and Layer 2 (verify against cited sources). Run with npm run evals:run -- --layers 2 --live. Worst-case output tokens are priced into every reservation, so keep the output caps tight.

links.$comment: WP41-S6. --check-links: every ## Sources link, once per run, through the same cache as Layer 2. dead = 404/410 or a network failure that repeats on retry; 401/403/429 are bot walls (blocked), never dead.
